LanguageData.PackHowls_Setting_WildAnswer_Desc: A few seconds after the colony's animals howl, up to three wild wolves or dogs on the map answer.
LanguageData.PackHowls_Setting_Moodlets_Desc: Colonists who hear the howl get a small bittersweet memory; family, lovers and the bonded master of the fallen get a stronger one.
LanguageData.PackHowls_Setting_Message_Desc: Show "The pack howls for ..." when it starts.
